chunks: Muḥammad ibn Muslim narrated from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام that he said:
“If there are three miles between the two villages, then there is no problem for these and those to gather, and there should not be less than three miles between the two congregations.”

key_terms.الْجَمَاعَتَيْنِ: the two congregations or assembled groups
key_terms.ثَلَاثَةُ أَمْيَالٍ: three miles; the stated legal distance
key_terms.فَلَا بَأْسَ: there is no problem; it is permissible
key_terms.يُجَمِّعَ: to hold the Jumuʿah gathering or congregational assembly

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum distance required between two Jumuʿah congregations according to Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the minimum distance between two villages or two congregational assemblies for Jumuʿah prayer. It indicates that when there is a separation of three miles, holding congregational gathering by both groups is unobjectionable, and the distance between the two congregations should not be less than three miles.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1258 - Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from Imam Abu Ja'far (as) who said:

"If there is a distance of three miles between two villages, then there is no problem for these and those to gather (for prayer), and there should not be less than three miles between the two congregations”.
